## Choosing Sample Subset

### Import packages
```{r}
#install.packages("tidyverse", repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org")
library(tidyverse)
```

### Assign paths
```{r}
all_reads_path <- "/scratch/projects/RCH-BIOL337/BIOL337_2026/MICROBIOME/DATA/SRADATA/rawData/"
metadata_path <- "/scratch/projects/RCH-BIOL337/BIOL337_2026/MICROBIOME/DATA/SraRunTable.csv"
```

### Get subset run IDs

There are many reads available to choose from. I will find reads for adult
tuatara collected at Takapourewa (Stephens Island), the source population.

```{r}
metadata <- read.csv(metadata_path)
subset <- metadata %>%
  filter(AGE == "Adult" & geo_loc_name == "New Zealand: Takapourewa")
nrow(subset)
```

There are 34 reads meeting the above criteria. The study found sex is also a small but still significant factor, so I will limit the subset to just one sex. I chose female because there are fewer.

```{r}
table(subset$sex)
```

```{r}
subset <- subset %>%
  filter(sex == "female")
```

Get just the reads:
```{r}
run_ids <- subset$Run
run_ids
```

### Transfer reads into working directory

I transferred the read files (.fastq.gz) into my working directory (~BIOL337_26S1/mod3_microbiome/data) manually.
